Bill.BriefDescription: Directing greater enforcement in certain areas of vehicle size, weight, and load laws.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to greater enforcement in certain areas of vehiclesize, weight, and load laws; and adding a new section to chapter 46.44RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The chief of the Washington state patrol shall assign at least onefulltime officer from the agency's commercial vehicle division to worksolely to enforce the size, weight, and load laws under this chapterwith respect to truck operators supporting the construction of a thirdrunway at any airport owned and operated by a countywide port districtwith a county population greater than one million five hundredthousand.
